props.name: onImport
props.description: Called with the typed rows when the import button is pressed.

props.name: onParsed
props.description: Called after every successful read, before import.

props.name: delimiter
props.description: Field separator, or `auto` to sniff it from the first lines.

props.name: header
props.description: Whether the first row names the columns, or `auto` to decide from the data.

props.name: previewRows
props.description: Rows shown in the preview table.

props.name: chunkSize
props.description: Bytes read per step when streaming a file.

props.name: defaultText
props.description: Text in the paste box at first — handy for demos.

props.name: file
props.description: A file to read as if it had been dropped; a new File object reads again.
